# Dora

## Overview

- **Age:** eight (since v3)  <sub>[v3 ch.Farewell P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001)</sub>
- **Gender:** female  <sub>[v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P5](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0005), [v3 ch.Farewell P1](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0001)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_
- **Family:** [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) (sibling)

## Appearance

Dora is characterized by a neat and proper appearance, often dressed in a nicely starched white dress accented with a black sash. She has gentle, mild hazel eyes, a straight nose, and long, sleek curls that consistently stay in order.

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044)_

## Personality

Dora is a remarkably quiet, demure, and well-behaved young girl who is considered a model child. Known for her neatness, industry, and faithful nature, she carries out her small duties carefully and systematically, never needing to be told how to do a task twice. She maintains a prim, proper, and placid demeanor, remaining composed and composedly silent unless spoken to directly. Though her steady, dispassionate approach to life makes her reliable, others note her somewhat monotonous temperament and note that her prim nature makes her less suited as a playmate for rowdy games. Despite her usual composure, she harbors a specific fear regarding [Mirabel](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) Cotton's deceased uncle.

_Sources: [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P33](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0033), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P30](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0030), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P1](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0001), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P44](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0044), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P85](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0085), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), +9 more_

## History

Dora and her twin brother, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), were left orphaned when their mother, Mary Keith, fell terminally ill. They were taken in to live at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) by [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), though Dora's brother quickly subjected her to wild antics, such as forcing her to walk a pigpen fence and pumping water over her dress. On one occasion, Dora went missing and was eventually found locked inside Mr. Harrison's toolhouse after [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) put her there. The twins were initially slated to stay only until fall, but after [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md) died, his trust fund allowed them to remain permanently at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables). Later, at school, Dora was deeply frightened when [Mirabel Cotton](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) scared her with tales of deceased relatives, prompting [Anne](../character/anne.md) to comfort her. While living at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), Dora was once convinced by [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) to skip [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school) to go fishing instead, after which [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) lied to cover their disobedience before eventually confessing. She later spent a June evening outside with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Anne](../character/anne.md), [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), and Mrs.

_Sources: [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P1](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0001), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P4](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0004), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P6](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0006), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P8](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0008), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P9](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0009), [v2 VII The Pointing of Duty P10](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0010), +524 more_

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--dora.md)

[Anne](../character/anne.md) serves as a teacher and caregiver figure for Dora, having helped persuade [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) to take her and her twin brother in after their mother fell ill. She helps raise Dora at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), taking on responsibilities such as helping with her sewing and managing the household alongside [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md).

- Student of — teacher helping to bring her up  <sub>[v2 XXVII An Afternoon at the Stone House P30](../source/v02-c27.md#nw-v02-c27-p0030)</sub>

### [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/davy-keith--dora.md)

[Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) is Dora's twin brother who came to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with her after their mother's death. Their relationship is marked by Davy's mischievous antics toward her, such as forcing her to walk a pigpen fence, ruining her dress with water, and locking her inside a neighbor's toolhouse.

- Sibling of — twin brother and sister  <sub>[v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P10](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0010), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P25](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0025), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P51](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0051), +7 more</sub>

### [Irving](../character/irving.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dora--irving.md)

Dora is a childhood acquaintance of [Irving](../character/irving.md). They are part of the broader circle of family and friends surrounding [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) during Anne's visits home from college.

- Friend of — childhood acquaintance  <sub>[v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P20](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0020)</sub>

### [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/dora--marilla-cuthbert.md)

[Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is Dora's adult guardian who took her and her twin brother in following the death of her cousin, Mary Keith. [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) provides a home for Dora at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and travels with her, while occasionally dealing with the household disruptions caused by the children.

- Comrade of — traveling companion to town  <sub>[v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P1](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0001)</sub>
